label: Page facsimile from OCR text (GDC scan not cached)
citation: Authentic open-access scans are TCGA pathology report PDFs on the NCI GDC. GDC was unreachable or returned no PDF during caching, so this demo shows a layout facsimile rendered from the publicly released TCGA-Reports OCR text. Re-run scripts/fetch_scan_pages.py when GDC is available to replace these images.
ocr_attribution: Kefeli et al., TCGA-Reports (Patterns 2024) — machine-readable text via AWS Textract
